6b20c1b0168f.en: Tryptify is a free hi-fi music player for Android, with a DSP console, headphone AutoEQ, bit-perfect USB DAC output and visualizers. Tryptify Cloud adds paid personal music storage made for fast streaming.

5d8a26bf34c4.en: The hi-fi player you can hear and watch.

8c3686449c26.en: This translation is provided for convenience. If it differs from the English version, the English version applies.

8830992fd374.en: These terms cover Tryptify Cloud, the paid music storage offered by tryptz ("we", "us"), and the Tryptify account you use to sign in to it. By starting a trial or a subscription you agree to them. The Tryptify app itself is free, open-source software under the GNU General Public License v3; that licence, not these terms, governs the app's code.

6414acd81ec7.en: Tryptify Cloud stores music files you upload and streams them back to you through the Subsonic API, for playback in the Tryptify app. The plans, their storage and their prices are listed on the pricing page.

ab21747b4721.en: You need a Tryptify account to use Tryptify Cloud, and you are responsible for keeping its sign-in safe. You must be at least 16 years old, or the age of digital consent where you live if that is higher. One person per account: do not share it.

20fd10110eaf.en: Payments are processed by Creem (creem.io), our merchant of record. Creem is the seller of record for your purchase and its own terms also apply to the payment. Subscriptions are billed in advance, monthly or yearly, and renew automatically at the same price until you cancel. Prices may include or add sales tax or VAT, as shown at checkout. If we change a price, the change applies from your next renewal after we tell you, and you can cancel before then.

5f95a11d4295.en: A 7-day free trial with 20 GB of storage is offered once per account, on monthly plans. A payment card is required to start it. If you do not cancel before the trial ends, the plan you chose starts and your card is charged for its first month.

ead498d26231.en: You can cancel at any time in the app (Settings › Connections › Tryptify Cloud › Manage or cancel subscription) or from the link in Creem's emails. You keep your plan until the end of the period you already paid for. See our refund policy for refunds.

e4a0b0529407.en: When a plan ends, by cancelling or because a payment fails, your library becomes read-only for 7 days: you can still play and download your music, but not upload. After those 7 days your files and library are permanently deleted. After a refund or a chargeback, this window is 2 days.

dff117782df0.en: You keep all rights to what you upload. You give us only the permission needed to store your files, process them (for example reading their tags and covers) and stream them back to you. You may upload only music you own or have the right to copy, for your own personal listening. Tryptify Cloud is not for distributing or publicly sharing music. We may remove content and suspend accounts that break this or the law, including after a valid copyright notice sent to the address below.

b348a18c4ffb.en: Tryptify Cloud and your Tryptify account may not be used for anything NSFW (not safe for work). You may not upload, store, stream, share or show sexually explicit content, nudity, pornography or any other adult material, in any form: music files and their cover art, file names and tags, your profile picture and name, themes and their pictures in the Theme Store, or messages in a listening party. This applies whether or not the material is legal where you live. We remove such content when we find it or it is reported to us, and may suspend or close the account that posted it. To report something, write to support@tryptify.com.

2d703dab2cb0.en: Each plan has a storage limit. Uploads stop when you reach it; you are never charged extra for going over. Single files may be up to 2 GB. Do not attempt to break, overload or get around the service's limits or security, or use it to store anything other than music and its cover art, which must follow section 8.

d41c424bb52b.en: We work to keep Tryptify Cloud fast and available, but it is provided "as is", without a guarantee of uninterrupted service. It is a streaming service, not a backup: always keep your own copies of your files.

31003b7b016b.en: To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential losses, or for lost data, and our total liability to you is limited to the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have as a consumer that cannot be limited by contract.

cd383d309b9f.en: We may suspend or close an account that seriously or repeatedly breaks these terms. If we ever stop offering Tryptify Cloud, we will tell you at least 30 days in advance so you can download your music, and refund any unused prepaid period.

077dd9a645e2.en: We may update these terms. If a change matters, we will tell you in the app or by email before it applies. Continuing to use the service after that means you accept the new terms.

294f4119bf1f.en: What Tryptify and Tryptify Cloud collect, why, and how to have it deleted.

9d74046d23c2.en: This policy explains what tryptz ("we") collects when you use the Tryptify app, a Tryptify account and Tryptify Cloud, and what we do with it. We do not sell your data and we do not show ads.

b545d87950d9.en: The Tryptify app keeps your library, settings and listening history on your phone. It sends data elsewhere only for features you turn on: signing in to sync favourites and playlists, scrobbling to Last.fm or ListenBrainz, showing what you play on Discord, connecting your own music server, or using Tryptify Cloud. Each of those services receives only what the feature needs.

828cbd0b6d75.en: When you sign in we receive your email address and an account id, and your name and picture if you sign in with Google. Accounts are run on Supabase.

4bf8c9e35773.en: Your music: the files you upload, their tags (title, artist, album and so on) and their covers, stored so we can stream them back to you.

d612a565041b.en: Your plan: which plan you have, until when it is paid, your storage use, and the customer and subscription ids from our payment provider.

f60f70d94ad9.en: Device sign-ins: a random password per device that plays your library, with the device's name (for example its model).

f3666a8fb517.en: Technical logs: our hosting provider keeps short-lived request logs (such as IP address and time) to keep the service running and secure.

1f1eb3f35f54.en: Your files and library data are stored with Cloudflare (R2 storage and D1 database).

2f236c18b899.en: Payments are handled by Creem (creem.io), our merchant of record, under its own privacy policy. We never see or store your card number; Creem tells us only whether you paid, for which plan and until when.

3a67718320bb.en: Your music and library are deleted 7 days after your plan ends (2 days after a refund or chargeback), or sooner if you ask. Billing records are kept as long as tax law requires. Your account stays until you ask us to delete it.

74369466fe6d.en: You can ask for a copy of your data, a correction, or its deletion, by writing to support@tryptify.com. Depending on where you live (for example in the EU, UK or California) you may have further rights, including to complain to your data protection authority.

29b82472d9bd.en: Tryptify Cloud is not meant for anyone under 16, and we do not knowingly collect their data.

df839df68daa.en: If we change this policy in a way that matters, we will say so in the app or by email before it applies.

effb1678c6e9.en: If Tryptify Cloud isn't right for you, write to support@tryptify.com within 14 days of a payment and we will refund that payment in full. Include the email you used at checkout.

ff3a5baae96a.en: The free trial costs nothing. Cancel before it ends and you are never charged.

8c8afad38fad.en: After 14 days a payment is not refunded, but you can cancel at any time so it does not renew. You keep your plan until the end of the period you paid for. Unused time is not refunded, except where the law requires it or if we stop offering the service.

f762c9067047.en: After a refund your plan ends straight away and your music stays downloadable for 2 days, then it is deleted. Download anything you need first.

5d8a0f3cf2cd.en: Refunds are made by Creem, our merchant of record, to the card you paid with. Your bank may take a few days to show it.
